summary.text: Drew Teitelbaum is the Republican candidate for the Nevada State Assembly, District 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Kamilah Bywaters (D).
The June 9, 2026 Republican primary was canceled.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Teitelbaum listed his campaign messages as making Nevada the best possible place for families, diversifying and strengthening the state's economy, and improving its education system.
He said he is passionate about infrastructure development, economic freedom and quality education.
